response.sql: SELECT scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor, AVG(scans.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(scans.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.scancount >= 11 GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor ORDER BY AVG(scans.pressratio) IS NULL, AVG(scans.pressratio) DESC LIMIT 10
